thesis.problem: Enterprise HR suites are priced and configured for companies with thousands of staff and an HR department to run them. The small and mid-sized firms that employ most of Europe were left running recruitment, contracts, absence and payroll preparation across spreadsheets, email threads and paper files.
thesis.solution: Personio packages the whole employee lifecycle, from applicant tracking and onboarding to digital personnel files, absence, performance and payroll preparation, into one subscription that a company without a dedicated HR systems team can configure itself. It is sold per employee per month and localised for each European country's payroll and employment rules.

sources.title: Personio nabs $200M at a $8.5B valuation as its HR for small businesses hits the big time
sources.quote: The company has picked up another $200 million at a new valuation of $8.5 billion, making it one of the most valuable startups in Europe at the moment.

sources.title: Personio raises $125M on a $1.7B valuation for an HR platform targeting SMEs
sources.quote: Personio — the German startup that targets small- and medium-sized businesses (10-2,000 employees) with an all-in-one HR platform covering recruiting and onboarding, payroll, absence tracking and other major HR functions — has picked up $125 million in funding at a $1.7 billion post-money valuation.
